name.surname: Brigham (widow Crosby\Crosbee)  1st cousin of Tho Brigham, Immigrant)
name.full: Lady Constance Brigham (widow Crosby\Crosbee)  1st cousin of Tho Brigham, Immigrant)

notes: TITLE UNSUPPORTED (research 2026-07-03): no source found gives her a peerage — compiled records describe her only as a widow (maiden name Brigham) who remarried into the Crosby family; "Lady" should be dropped, as should "Lord" on husband Robert Crosby (I182620315152). Core vitals otherwise corroborate: b. ca.1602 likely at Holme-on-Spalding-Moor, Yorkshire (the export's "Moore, Yorkshire" is a truncation of this place name), d. 1683/buried 25 Jan 1683 at Rowley, Essex Co., MA, arriving in New England ca. Dec 1638 aboard the John of London as a widow. Sources: WikiTree Brigham-88; Find a Grave #38453033. See also note on son(?) John Crosby (I182620315134) — her documented children were daughters, making that link doubtful.
